decisions.reason: The power-button lighting effect is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The specific rendered controls, labels, and back-panel details implement the existing reference-rendering theme without changing the candidate's broader visual identity state.
Reproducing the rendered button appearance does not alter the existing cursive E markings, coverage, or lettering color.
The candidate already requires colors from the CAD renderings, and the source supplies no different color or finish value.
The logo along the bottom is distinct from the Elena's Chai Whisk placard, whose text, position, orientation, and display sides remain unchanged.
The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already captures the required bottom logo; the back-panel styling is owned by the source Requirement.
The source addresses colors, controls, labels, lighting, logos, and the back panel, not the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication.
The candidate already requires the beige reference-matched finish, and the source does not establish a replacement finish value.
Rendered button appearance does not change the solenoid actuation mechanism or press-and-release dispensing behavior.
Lighting and visual styling around the power button do not change the dedicated power-button control method.
The visual-design decision does not alter pour control, beverage preservation, flow behavior, or the dispensing path.
The source changes visual details only and does not alter splash targets, speed conditions, or mitigation options.
